drivingQuestion: Is the owner forced to redeem his field once another has bid higher, or only permitted to?
outcomeNote: A single lemma with a strict inference drawn from it; the reason for the inference is supplied in the following unit.

segments.he: אָמַר אֶחָד: הֲרֵי הִיא שֶׁלִּי בְּעֶשְׂרִים וָשֵׁשׁ כּוּ׳. רָצוּ — אִין, לֹא רָצוּ — לָא.
segments.en: § The mishna teaches that in a case where the owner offers to pay twenty sela and «one» other person «said:» The field is «hereby mine for twenty-six» sela, if the owner wished to pay thirty-one sela and a dinar, the owner takes precedence. The Gemara elaborates: If the owner «wished» to pay the additional sum, then «yes,» he redeems the field, but if the owner «did not wish» to do so, «no,» he is not forced to redeem it.
